diagnostics.availability: Baseline signal t+10 -> scheduled Open t+15. Report signed drift and frozen-level reward erosion. Separate fixed t+15 availability sensitivity -> Open t+20, not parameter optimization.
diagnostics.session_vwap: Baseline reset-after-gap unchanged. Compare with observed-window anchored accumulator; mark incomplete windows, never claim missing weights recoverable or true transaction/session VWAP.
diagnostics.uncertainty: No full annual PF/Net/DD when any unresolved path outcome; NO_COVERAGE for pre-inception months. Available-history diagnostic is not a full calendar year.

execution.C1: one dated tick per executed abstract unit per side, separate cost column only; no additional ordinary fees/spread/slippage; gaps remain in reference prices
execution.TP: precommitted passive target; only strict penetration >= one dated tick; reference TP, no gap improvement; touch alone NONFILL; none in entry bar
execution.TTL: one scheduled bar only for entries; cancel unfilled entry remainder; exits retry next strictly eligible full research bar, residual retained
execution.ambiguity: Stop-first; entry-bar adverse Stop permitted, TP forbidden; flag ambiguity, unknown within-bar timestamp recorded as interval
execution.boundary: Original B-20 intent and B-10 confirmation reserve retained as parameters; derived submission deadline backs off until next_slot(sent+decision+order delay)+availability <= B-10. Nominal t+10 => submit B-25, scenario at B-20, ack B-10. Missing/late/nonfill does not prove FLAT.
execution.classification: CONDITIONAL_ON_OBSERVED_ADMISSIBLE_BAR; no physically submitted LIVE orders
execution.funding: no snapshot crossed only when flat before boundary; any boundary/emergency unresolved liability => Net_model_C1 null, funding/extra liability UNRESOLVED; no funding credit or zero-imputation
execution.gap: Missing path with existing exposure => possible Stop/Take/no-exit branches unknown. No numerical exit, exit quantity, exit C1 or P&L. A pre-scheduled conditional reduce-all on an observed allowed bar establishes model-flat only on its availability acknowledgement. Null trade Net/PF; unresolved outcome/funding persists. Retry if conditional full reduction not confirmed.
execution.information: execution results and observations delivered at bar start+10m (or later known delivery); decisions never receive future OHLCV or existence
execution.liquidity: Full abstract-unit scenario on eligible observed bars only; no queue/capacity/exchange-fill evidence. Nonfill on observed cap/protection/zero synthetic capacity; absent entry is NO_BAR_NO_MODEL_FILL.
execution.live_fail_closed: Original m5_baseline.Replay (v1) retained byte-for-byte for unknown submitted-order scenario. Real order acknowledgement/reconciliation remains necessary; v2 is not a LIVE engine.
execution.marketable: reference Open of pre-scheduled full bar with start strictly > ready; fill only if Open respects pre-known cap and stop<entry<take (long), take<entry<stop (short); never choose later favourable bar
execution.missing_entry: At target+availability, missing/unavailable exact TTL slot => NO_BAR_NO_MODEL_FILL; no model position, no price/cost, no LIVE NONFILL/cancel assertion. Late target delivery never revives expired scenario.
execution.price_limits: cap is model order price cap, NOT verified venue historical price band
execution.stop: resident precommitted conditional stop; adverse gap min(Open,Stop) long / max(Open,Stop) short; intrabar touch at Stop is explicitly accepted stop scenario

tick.CNYRUBF: 0.01 before 2023-09-27 19:00 MSK, 0.001 from then; each side dated independently

execution.unit: one abstract normalized price exposure unit, NOT automatic real q=1; PARTIAL test adapter uses integer abstract units only

metric_policy: normalized price units and net R; no real equity %, CAGR or portfolio returns; unresolved cases retain exposure and liabilities, global Net/PF only CLOSED-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC where incomplete; 12 months include NO_COVERAGE and covered zero-trade separately

provenance.volume: positive relative OHLCV weights only; NOT verified contracts/capacity

rules.ATR: simple mean of 12 previous true ranges; each TR needs previous close; exclude signal bar
rules.Momentum_LONG: signal close > highest High of previous 12 bars; SHORT close < lowest Low of previous 12 bars; shifted range excludes signal
rules.VWAP: OHLCV approximation: cumulative typical=(H+L+C)/3 times relative Volume / cumulative relative Volume in research window; common normalization cancels; gap/window reset
rules.VWAP_LONG: previous close <= previous VWAP - 1*ATR and signal close > current VWAP - 1*ATR and signal close < current VWAP; SHORT symmetric; ATR is shifted signal ATR for both comparisons
rules.VWAP_take: current signal VWAP frozen at decision; no moving target
rules.holding: UNCHANGED: MAX_HOLD request at entry start + hold - 5m; next strictly eligible slot; late t+10 ack can exceed nominal holding confirmation time. Separate corrected session submission deadline.
rules.one_position: one abstract model unit per independent run; no actual contract quantity, equity/GO sizing or averaging; pending orders reserve position
rules.protection: absolute Stop/Take frozen around signal Close using shifted ATR; cap at Close +/- 0.25 ATR; long stop rounded up, TP up, cap down; short stop down, TP down, cap up
rules.warmup: 13 contiguous positive-weight M5 observations before signal; ATR reset on any missing slot and at each window; no previous-day/context carry
